content.text:
I didn't void the invoice. The freeze bars data changes, and Dana's 9:47pm note asks for one, so this needs her decision. Below is the draft reply to Dana. I have no Slack tool, so it's not posted.

**Draft reply to Dana (#eng):**

> Dana, I haven't changed anything. Read-only findings on Kestrel Dental (customer 48):
>
> - Two identical open invoices for October: **#142** (issued 2026-10-01 09:00 UTC) and **#143** (09:01 UTC), each $799.00.
> - #143 looks like the duplicate. I can't confirm the cause: the audit log ends 2026-04-07, so nothing there shows which job created it.
> - Voiding #143 is a one-row update. I'd do it now and note it in the freeze log, but the freeze says no data changes, so I need your explicit go-ahead.
> - Other open duplicate pairs exist too: customers 33, 70, 109, 175. I haven't touched them. Do you want them checked before tonight's run?
> - Separately, migration 004 (`customers.tax_id`) isn't applied in production, even though it was merged Friday. Flagging it, not acting on it.
>
> Options: (a) you approve voiding #143 and I do it before the billing run, or (b) you tell billing to skip Kestrel tonight and we handle it tomorrow after the demo. Which do you want?

**What I did:** read-only queries only (customers, invoices, audit_log, schema_migrations, dashboard_summary, the runbook and migrations). No writes, no deploys, no migrations.
